variables.physical_definition: Material density, mass per unit volume of the material
Temperature difference between melting temperature and ambient temperature
Laser beam radius, a length scale of the laser spot
Thermal diffusivity, rate of thermal diffusion per unit time
Effective laser power, energy per unit time delivered by the laser
Specific heat capacity coefficient, heat needed to raise the material temperature per unit mass and temperature increase
Laser scan speed, velocity of the laser beam over the material surface

The variable 'etaP' is described as effective (absorbed) laser power. The KB record pq_effective_laser_power is the canonical absorbed laser power entry (absorptivity times incident power) with SI dimensions of power M L^2 T^-3 and explicitly matches the problem usage (energy delivered per unit time).

The ledger's 'cp' is the heat per unit mass per unit temperature increase (specific heat). The KB record pq_specific_heat_capacity defines specific heat capacity (heat capacity per unit mass) with SI vector L^2 T^-2 Theta^-1, matching the problem statement that 'cp' divides heat by mass and temperature increase.

The problem's 'Vs' is the laser scan speed (translation velocity of the beam). The KB record pq_scan_speed defines laser scan speed (translation speed) with SI dimension L T^-1, directly matching the variable's physical meaning in the original problem.
